# Polycollaboration  technology

Powering authentic human connection and collaboration

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![Studio X70 TC10](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Studio-X70-TC10-b.png)

HP Poly is a collaboration provider that combines HP’s computing technology with Poly’s cutting-edge innovations in audio and video. In August 2022, HP acquired Poly, bringing video conferencing solutions, cameras, headsets, voice and software to HP Inc. As an Amplify Power partner, AVI-SPL and HP Poly offer world-class solutions designed to integrate seamlessly with the platform and services of your choice. HP AI-powered technologies address the challenges of in-office and remote work, providing innovative solutions that save time, reduce costs, and ensure your business is always shown in the best light.

For more information, please visit [Poly’s Product Catalog](https://shop.avispl.com/collections/poly).

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/hp-poly/#contact)

## Real-Time Design with HP Poly

Experience how to validate your HP Poly room designs before you build them. No headset or specialty hardware needed!

[Schedule a VR demo](https://avispl.com/hp-poly/#contact)

![HP Amplify IMPACT HP PARTNER PROGRAM](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/HP-Amplify-IMPACT-HP-PARTNER-PROGRAM-lg2.png)

### HP Amplify IMPACT

AVI-SPL is proud to be an **HP Amplify Impact Partner**. Through this program, we join HP in driving progress on sustainability, human rights, and digital equity. This partnership reflects our commitment to delivering world-class collaboration solutions in ways that support people, communities, and the planet.

[Learn more About HP Amplify Impact](https://www.hp.com/us-en/newsroom/press-releases/2022/hp-accelerates-partner-sustainability.html)

![HP day3 Voyager 85 Ambiente](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/hp_day3_voyager_85_ambiente.png)

### HP Poly Certifications

AVI-SPL carries these HP Poly Certifications:

- HP Poly Video Sales Expert
- HP Poly Video Professional
- HP Poly Video Specialist
- HP Poly Headset Sales Expert
- HP Poly Headset Specialist

![HP Poly Studio 7 Room Compute with MTR](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/HP-Poly-Studio-7-Room-Compute-with-MTR.png)

### Versatile Room Solutions

With HP Poly and Microsoft Teams, you’ll do more than just show up, you’ll stand out in your small to large rooms that need a PC-based Microsoft Teams system. The HP Poly Studio G9 Plus base kit for Microsoft Teams. includes HP Mini IP Conferencing PC with Microsoft Teams Rooms and a HP Poly TC10 Touch Controller.

- Pro-grade, easy to use and work seamlessly with Microsoft Teams.
- Pair with HP Poly video bars and A/V for a versatile single-vendor solution that fits any sized room need.
- Our Teams certified headsets, video and audio-conferencing products, desk phones, and software are beautifully designed and engineered to connect people with incredible clarity.


##### All-in-One meeting    room solutions

The built-in software used by our all-in-one solutions provides everything you need for a successful video call.

##### PC-Based Room    Solutions

Come fully equipped with Poly AI-driven audio and video technologies, an HP collaboration mini-PC, and easy-to-use controller, so your Microsoft Teams or Zoom room experience is seamless.

##### Premium    Headsets

Beautifully designed Poly headsets allow users to hear and be heard with precision, minimize distractions, and ensure superior audio quality.

##### Phones

Beautifully designed business phones and conference solutions – Easy to set up, easy to use, and compatible with almost any platform.

##### Platform    Solutions

Poly provides purpose-built solutions certified and optimized to work with Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google and others.

##### Poly    Innovations

Poly provides unparalleled noise reduction and noise-cancelling features in the market, including Poly NoiseBlockAI, Poly Acoustic Fence, WindSmart Technology, and SoundGuard.

Poly DirectorAI, smart camera technology, improves the video-conferencing experience by using advanced AI and machine learning.
